items.html: It is found, then, that the essentiality, although it is divided into two, is nevertheless not in the internality as one part only — the inner within the two aspects of the vessels, and the second part surrounding above the two aspects of the vessels, outside them all. Indeed, within the vessels there is only one light alone, and it is within the inner vessel — not one within the outer and one within the inner. Rather, there is only a single inner light (Or Pnimi) within the inner vessels, and the inner vessels are within the outer vessels.
